lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance, circular spots arranged in vertical columns of 3-5 visible points, with horizontal spacing roughly equal to vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with the horizontal alignment of spots to form a matrix-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting high local contrast with luminance peaks along the ridge crest and shadow gradients immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of smaller, less-ordered high-luminance spots on the visible portion of the pectoral fin.
